description: A set of natural numbers is computably enumerable exactly when it is empty or the range of a primitive-recursive unary function.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.UniversalComputation.enumerable_iff_primitive_range (A : ℕ → Prop) :
  REPred A ↔ (∀ (x : ℕ), ¬A x) ∨ ∃ f, Nat.Primrec f ∧ ∀ (y : ℕ), A y ↔ ∃ x, f x = y
